svg.text: Same lattice, same proton seed — two configurations
P and E share one complete face (green).
Existing occupancy rule; phase compatibility not asserted.
P/N and N/E share complete faces.
P/E share an edge (white), not a face.
Marked-window construction; not the pair plus a hidden N.
Faint edges: neighbouring lattice cells. Colours: P blue · N gold · E pink. No new particle or duality rule introduced.
